name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Holds early clicks for a few ms when they would kill you. Practice tool.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the buffer on or off. You can also use the toggle key while playing.

toggle-key.name: Toggle Key
toggle-key.description: Turns the buffer on or off while you're in a level.

buffer-releases.name: Buffer Releases
buffer-releases.description: Also hold back early <cy>releases</c> for wave, ship and robot, where letting go too early can kill you.

modes-title.name: Max Delay Per Gamemode (ms)
modes-title.description: How late an early click is allowed to be moved, in milliseconds. 0 turns it off for that mode. At 240 TPS one physics step is about 4.17 ms, so 8.5 ms = 2 steps (the old Stage 1).

ship-ms.name: Ship
ship-ms.description: Off by default (the original version never buffered ship).

show-feedback.name: Show Timing Feedback
show-feedback.description: Pops up how early your click was every time it gets buffered.

show-stats.name: Show Counter
show-stats.description: Keeps a small line on screen with how many inputs got buffered this attempt and this session.

look-ahead-ms.name: Look-Ahead
look-ahead-ms.description: How far ahead (ms) the mod simulates to decide if a click kills you. Longer catches more, but past the next obstacle you'd need another input anyway, so too long makes it give up more often.

wave-look-ahead-ms.name: Wave Look-Ahead
wave-look-ahead-ms.description: Same as Look-Ahead but for wave, which hits walls a lot sooner.

min-gain-ms.name: Min Survival Gain
min-gain-ms.description: A delayed click only counts if it either survives the whole look-ahead or lives at least this many ms longer than the original click.

debug-log.name: Debug Logging
debug-log.description: Writes every decision to the Geode log (open it with the Geode console).
